NCAA Admits Replay Errors in Michigan-Western Michigan Game

The NCAA has acknowledged that replay protocol errors occurred during the Western Michigan-Michigan game. Despite these admitted mistakes, the organization reiterated that the result of the game cannot be changed. The College Football Playoff (CFP) committee has issued a statement clarifying its response mechanisms to such game outcomes. The controversy centers on the clock management during replay reviews in the Western Michigan-Michigan contest.
